detail.longDescription: Hello, Fediverse. We're Primod, a small team building runtime security for Kubernetes and Linux workloads. Here we'll share what we learn about the gap between what a scanner lists and what actually runs in production: reachable CVEs, runtime evidence, and detection that holds up in an incident. No hype, and one post a day at most. https:// primod.io/blog?utm_source=mast odon&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=intro # introduction # Kubernetes # infosec
